voiceAlignment.retimeRule: When final narration exists, update scene and caption frame boundaries from measured phrase anchors; retain IDs and save as a new timing version.
voiceAlignment.alignmentRule: Align Thai captions to phrase boundaries and actual pauses; manually listen-check transcription and wording. Do not infer speech timing from character count alone.
voiceAlignment.frameRounding: Round measured boundaries to the nearest frame at fps.
